PapyrusAI.

A guided generative AI environment that helps students strengthen their writing while learning to use AI thoughtfully and critically.

Open PapyrusAI →All platforms

About the platform

An AI coach for the writing process.

PapyrusAI gives students structured ways to work with a large language model during planning, drafting, and revision. Embedded prompts support productive dialogue instead of simply generating a finished paper.

Instructors can select or design prompt sets, align feedback with assignments and rubrics, and review how students use the platform.

LearnersSecondary and postsecondary writers
FocusWriting development and AI literacy
AccessWeb, Google sign-in, and participating Canvas courses

How it supports learning

Scaffold the work without offloading it.

Plan and Develop Ideas

Socratic dialogue helps students clarify a topic, outline, or argument.

Receive Guided Feedback

Students receive feedback on organization, content, language, and assignment-specific goals.

Build AI Literacy

Structured interactions give students practice prompting, evaluating, and incorporating AI feedback.
